title.narrative: To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for all people in Kenya with TB, leprosy and lung diseases - Kenya (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Kenya, Tuberculosis, Amref Health Africa (Amref Kenya)This program has the following goals: Contribute to attainment of universal health coverage through comprehensive TB/HIV prevention, treatment and care for all people in kenya.. To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for all people in Kenya with Tuberculosis.. The objectives of this program are: To build sustainable resilient systems for health and community, preparedness for emergency, pandemic, and response to in-country public health events to limit transmission, morbidity, and mortality by strengthening integrated disease surveillance and deployment of community-based surveillance systems.. To build a motivated, skilled, equitably distributed health and community workforce through capacity building, supportive supervision and deployment of digital tools and integrated health information system.. To improve the supply of quality medical oxygen through the procurement of bulk oxygen sources, oxygen distribution infrastructure and improved access of respiratory care and therapeutics. To strengthen laboratory systems at national and subnational levels for early detection and monitoring of disease outbreaks, identifying emerging pathogens, and informing public health decision-making by development and dissemination of guidelines, expanding integrated simple referral and multi-disease testing platforms.
